function.name: product_sale_stats
function.description: Get product sales statistics including sales amount, quantity, and order count for products sold within a specified date range, with pagination support.

startDate.description: Optional start date (inclusive) for filtering sales. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

endDate.description: Optional end date (inclusive) for filtering sales. Format: yyyy-MM-dd

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
